purpose: Boundary experiments for What Simple Readouts Miss in Continuous Language Diffusion; no automatic broadening to all continuous language models
status_at_creation: Official code and metadata inspected; no new checkpoint outputs or outcome measurements inspected

calm.unit: One 128-dimensional latent representing four tokens; four position-specific affine classifiers, full vocabulary
calm.data: Local OpenWebText parquet shard 79, unique exact document hashes; seed 61102001; first 256 tokens per eligible document, no BOS or padding; 4096 fit, 256 validation, 512 test documents
calm.training_states: One posterior sample per four-token chunk, fixed seed 61102002, from the released autoencoder
calm.targets: Native decoder argmax on the identical state; reference reconstruction measured separately
calm.initialization: Ridge regression of final native decoder features on the raw latent plus intercept, alpha=1e-3 times mean Gram diagonal; unpenalized intercept. The effective affine vocabulary head uses the original tied unembedding. Initialization alone is also retained.
calm.fit: Three AdamW fits (seeds 17,29,43); 2048 updates, 64 chunks per batch, learning rate 0.0003, weight decay 0.01; full-vocabulary cross entropy; fixed budget, no claimed affine optimum
calm.validation: Evaluate after 0,512,1024,2048 updates; maximize native token agreement, earliest tie; no test-based model selection
test_conditions: posterior mean plus isotropic Gaussian noise of coordinate SD 0.25
calm.primary: Native-decision agreement on the fixed posterior-sample test, averaged over fitting seeds; separate four-token exact agreement
controls: Radial scale 0.5 and 2 on the same posterior sample; no direction changes
calm.generation_extension: If CALM-M weights load successfully, collect teacher-prefix-conditioned latent predictions from disjoint test documents at temperature 1 using official generative_head.sample. These are conditional one-step predictions, not free-running benchmark reproduction; reference continuation agreement is not generation correctness.
calm.inference: 4000 paired document bootstrap draws, seed 61102009, 95% descriptive intervals; one checkpoint and one source corpus; fitting seeds are not pretrained model replicas

llaco.scope: Released geometry and learned directional adapter component; no claim of full 8B model benchmark replication or contextual decoder replacement
llaco.data: 1024 uniformly sampled non-special nonzero codewords, seed 61102101; one paired random spherical and mask-biased endpoint per source; 256 development and 768 test, no method selection from test
llaco.trajectories: Gamma=0,0.5,0.8,0.9,0.95,0.98,1 with official slerp and mask-biased terminal_noise; retain full vocabulary competitors including special tokens
llaco.radial_control: Scale the exact same state by 0.1,0.5,1,2; theoretical invariance checked for cosine and normalized adapter, not asserted for arbitrary contextual decoder
llaco.method_pilot: Mass-budgeted adapter expectation: compute full vocabulary posterior, use shortest leading set with mass >=1-epsilon when k<=64, otherwise exact dense expectation; epsilon=0.001 and 0.01 both retained, no winner selection
llaco.bound: For omitted mass delta, renormalized retained expectation differs by at most 2*delta*max_v||embedding_v|| in Euclidean norm; this bounds adapter input error, not final decoded tokens or task quality
baselines: Algebraically exact dense FP32 full softmax expectation
llaco.runtime: Batch4, FP32 accumulation, warmup5 repetitions20, same device and inputs; complete adapter work including similarities, posterior, selection, and gathering; no denoiser or end-to-end speedup claim
llaco.failure_policy: Retain all signs, nulls, expensive fallbacks and overheads; optimized dense exact baseline must be reported even if sparse loses

resources: One GPU inference/training worker on idle GPU2 with 12 GiB allocator cap and 2 GiB additional free headroom; at most two CPU threads per compute worker; bounded HTTP range downloads; never alter others' jobs
paper_inclusion: Cite both primary works with accurate distinctions. Put bounded experiments and limitations in a compact appendix and connect them briefly to the main scope. No invented causal or universal algorithmic claims. Preserve all prior evidence.
